description: This file implements utilities for parametrizing PyTorch neural network modules, including registration, removal, transfer, and management of parametrizations and their associated tensors or buffers. It defines classes like ParametrizationList and functions for handling parametrizations, caching, and class modifications.

classes.name: ParametrizationList
classes.description: A container managing original tensors or buffers of a parametrized module, supporting right_inverse and forward operations, used internally for handling multiple parametrizations.

methods.name: cached
methods.description: Context manager that enables caching of parametrized tensors during forward passes to avoid recomputation.

methods.name: register_parametrization
methods.description: Registers a parametrization module to a tensor or buffer in a given module, enabling parametrized transformations with optional safety checks.

methods.name: is_parametrized
methods.description: Checks if a module has a parametrization applied to a specific tensor or any tensor if no name is given.

methods.name: remove_parametrizations
methods.description: Removes parametrizations from a tensor in a module, optionally leaving the parametrized tensor as is or restoring the original.

methods.name: type_before_parametrizations
methods.description: Returns the original class type of a module before parametrizations were applied.

methods.name: transfer_parametrizations_and_params
methods.description: Transfers parametrizations and their associated tensors from one module to another, optionally for a specific tensor.
